name: murmur-agent-chat-mcp
description: Durable, push-signaled agent-to-agent messaging over MCP

scripts.lint: biome lint --error-on-warnings . && bun run scripts/check-safety.ts && bun run scripts/check-file-lines.ts && bun run scripts/check-dependencies.ts && bun run scripts/check-documentation.ts
scripts.test:coverage: bun run scripts/require-hosted-coverage.ts && bun run scripts/run-coverage.ts
scripts.test:linux: bun run scripts/require-cross-platform-test.ts && MURMUR_TEST_DOCKER_IMAGE=oven/bun:1.3.11 bun test test/cloud-cross-platform.mcp.e2e.test.ts
scripts.test:portability: bun test test/check-dependencies.test.ts test/check-documentation.test.ts test/check-file-lines.test.ts test/check-safety.test.ts test/check-coverage.test.ts test/entrypoints.test.ts test/configuration-boundaries.test.ts test/user-configuration.test.ts test/portability.test.ts test/repository-context.test.ts test/store.test.ts test/sqlite-message-concurrency.test.ts test/sqlite-message-upgrades.test.ts test/http-capacity.test.ts test/mcp-resources.test.ts test/murmur-tool-definitions.test.ts test/observability.test.ts test/telemetry.test.ts test/resource-lifecycle.test.ts test/safe-errors.test.ts test/security-boundaries.test.ts
scripts.verify: bun run typecheck && bun run lint && bun run format:check
